title: Update embedded spec and Anytype-Version header to 2025-11-08
description: Branch embeds scripts/openapi.json at API version 2025-05-20 and hardcodes Anytype-Version: 2025-05-20 in rust/src/client/http_client.rs (plus tests in rust/src/client/mod.rs). Main targets 2025-11-08 with ~1800 lines of spec changes. Merge main or copy scripts/openapi.json, then update the header constant and tests.
close_reason: Spec/tools.json pulled from main (2025-11-08); ANYTYPE_API_VERSION constant in http_client.rs; commit 5613af3

title: Parser: resolve $refs and port TS schema handling
description: rust/src/openapi/parser.rs substitutes {"type":"object"} for any $ref instead of resolving it, leaving many tool input schemas untyped. Port TS parser behavior from src/openapi/parser.ts at main: strip 'filters' params (FilterExpression excluded), exclude Anytype-Version header param from schemas, collapse icon oneOf to emoji-only, flatten PropertyValue/PropertyLinkValue unions, rewrite format:binary to file-path fields, append error-response docs to descriptions.
close_reason: Parser rewrite in commit 24d4a98: auth excluded (34 tools), refs resolved with cycle detection, TS schema handling ported, API-kebab naming

title: Exclude Auth-tagged operations from MCP tool list
description: TS parser skips operations tagged 'Auth'; Rust exposes create_auth_challenge and create_api_key as MCP tools (36 tools vs main's 34). Filter Auth-tagged operations in rust/src/openapi/parser.rs convert_to_tools().
close_reason: Parser rewrite in commit 24d4a98: auth excluded (34 tools), refs resolved with cycle detection, TS schema handling ported, API-kebab naming

title: Implement real get-key challenge flow
description: rust/src/auth/key_generator.rs prints manual instructions and pings /health only. Port the TS flow from src/auth/get-key.ts at main: POST /v1/auth/challenges with {app_name}, prompt for the 4-digit code, POST /v1/auth/api_keys with {challenge_id, code}, print the API key and ready-to-paste MCP config. Main specifically fixed this to use non-deprecated endpoints (commit 50aa3da).
close_reason: Challenge flow implemented (challenges + api_keys endpoints), verified reachable-path and failure-path behavior; commit b86bcc2

title: Support ANYTYPE_API_BASE_URL env var and 127.0.0.1 default
description: Main added ANYTYPE_API_BASE_URL (src/utils/base-url.ts): origin-only URL validation (http/https), drives base URL and default spec fetch URL {origin}/docs/openapi.json; default base URL changed to http://127.0.0.1:31009. Rust only knows ANYTYPE_MCP_*-prefixed figment vars, ANYTYPE_API_KEY, and OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS, and defaults to localhost:31009. Add the env var to rust/src/config/mod.rs and update defaults in key_generator.rs and json_rpc_server.rs.
close_reason: ANYTYPE_API_BASE_URL supported with origin-only validation; DEFAULT_BASE_URL=127.0.0.1:31009; commit 049e75c

title: File upload: detect file params from spec, accept local paths
description: TS detects file params from multipart/form-data schemas (type:string, format:binary) and streams local file paths via FormData (src/openapi/file-upload.ts, src/client/http-client.ts). Rust uses an ad-hoc _file_upload key accepting data-URLs/base64/paths in rust/src/client/http_client.rs. Align with spec-driven detection so LLM-facing tool schemas advertise file path fields.
close_reason: Spec-driven multipart via file_upload_params; path params no longer leak into query/body; commit c8ef216

title: Align tool naming: kebab-case with 64-char truncation
description: TS emits kebab-case tool names (operationId underscores to hyphens) with 64-char MCP name limit and uniqueness suffixes; Rust emits raw snake_case operation IDs. Client-visible difference; decide whether to match TS naming in rust/src/openapi/parser.rs.
close_reason: Parser rewrite in commit 24d4a98: auth excluded (34 tools), refs resolved with cycle detection, TS schema handling ported, API-kebab naming

title: Implement or remove advertised SSE/streamable-http transports
description: --mode sse|streamable-http silently falls back to stdio (rust/src/server/hybrid_server.rs, json_rpc_server.rs start_sse). Either implement streamable HTTP via rmcp 3.1 transport-streamable-http-server feature or drop the CLI flags (main is stdio-only). Silent fallback violates fail-loud.
close_reason: Removed fake transports and hybrid facade; stdio-only like main; commit f21342d

title: Add CI, Docker, and MCP registry manifest for Rust crate
description: Main gained Docker support (Dockerfile-multi-stage), CI running tests, and an MCP registry server.json. The rust/ crate has none: add cargo fmt/clippy/test CI job, optionally a Dockerfile and registry manifest.
close_reason: rust-ci.yml added (fmt/clippy/build/test, path-filtered). Docker image and registry manifest deliberately descoped: rust crate is not yet the published artifact; commit 336d769
